newsitem.title: USA: Reynolds & Reynolds sees earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds & Reynolds sees earnings growth.

text.p: Reynolds & Reynolds Co said Monday it expected the growth rate for its sales and earnings for the rest of the year to outpace the rate registered for the fiscal second quarter ended March 31.
"We see growth opportunities in all of our businesses through the rest of the year," it said.

"Our cash position remains strong, enabling us to continue our investments in new products and services," it added. "We have solid acquisition opportunities near term that will further strengthen our market position."

The company, which provides information management systems to businesses, reported earnings of $0.31 a share for the second quarter, up from $0.27 a year earlier. Consolidated net sales and revenues rose to $345.2 million from $257.0 million.
The First Call's consensus earnings estimate among analysts was $0.32 a share.
The First Call estimate is $0.34 a share for the third quarter and $0.37 for the fourth quarter.
